help_body:
Sources: arrows select; Enter starts. f edits BPF, i selects a capture file, e sets a NEW PCAP output path. Clear an input to disable it.

Session: 1 overview, 2 inspect, 3 notifications, 4 firewall. Space pauses capture; u changes units; m compact mode. Tab selects a panel; * toggles a favorite; f filters favorites; t changes sort; g groups hosts. Enter opens the selected item. / searches (= exact, ! excludes, != differs).

Inspect: b proposes blocking the remote IP, B the executable. Confirm explicitly. Firewall: d removes a selected recorded rule. Administrative privileges are required.

Settings: arrows select; Enter activates. s settings; a About; Esc back. q quits from sources.

The Git link is disabled until configured.
Esc closes help.
